full_prompt_en: A square surreal ink-and-wash illustration shows a pale young woman in left-facing profile above a dark undulating sea. Her small face has a fine graphite outline, a lowered mouth, and a calm distant gaze. Dark hair sweeps back into an enormous sculptural arrangement that occupies most of the upper half: curled blue-gray locks, floral whorls, leaf-like shapes, and dense storm clouds interweave into one mass. White puffy cloud layers cross the hair horizontally, with a dark bird silhouette lifting near the top right and a few ochre leaves tucked among the curls. Her high pale collar and dark dress occupy the lower center. Behind her, a low horizon separates a lightly lined ivory sky from charcoal waves, and two tiny white sailboats punctuate the water at different distances. A small dark bird appears near the left horizon. The entire image uses precise fine hatching, engraved curves, and restrained watercolor-like gray shading. The face remains nearly white and smooth, while hair, clouds, and waves carry much denser marks. Ink-dark blue, slate gray, ivory, and selective ochre form a narrow palette. Light is diffuse and cool, making the cloud tops and face pale without sharp cast shadows. The composition balances a large ornate upper silhouette against low broad wave bands, with the profile as a quiet hinge between them. There is no readable text. The whole illustration feels reflective and dreamlike, turning thought, weather, and landscape into a single carefully drawn visual form.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实墨线与淡彩插画描绘一位浅色年轻女子的左向侧脸，身下是深暗起伏海面。小巧面孔有精细石墨轮廓、微垂嘴角和安静遥远的目光。深发向后扫成巨大的雕塑性结构，占据上半部大部分：卷起的蓝灰发绺、花形旋涡、叶形和浓密风暴云相互交织。白色蓬云横穿发髻，右上附近一只深色飞鸟剪影升起，数片赭叶藏在卷发间。高而淡色的衣领与深衣占下方中央。身后，低地平线把细线描绘的象牙天空与炭灰波浪分开，两只微小白帆船在不同距离点破水面。左侧地平线附近另有一只小深鸟。整幅图使用准确细排线、版刻弯线与克制的水彩般灰色塑形。脸几乎保持白色和平滑，头发、云与浪则承载密得多的笔痕。墨蓝黑、石板灰、象牙与选择性赭色组成狭窄调色。光漫射而冷，使云顶与脸淡白，没有锐利投影。构图以庞大华丽上方剪影平衡低位宽阔波带，侧脸成为两者间安静的铰点。没有可读文字。整幅插画沉思如梦，把想法、天气和风景化为一个精细绘制的视觉形体。
style_prompt_en: Surreal ink-and-wash illustration fuses large organic masses with atmospheric and landscape-like textures. Precise fine hatching and engraved curls grow denser in the upper field, while smooth ivory reserves keep a small central contour legible. Ink-dark blue, slate gray, and pale cream dominate, with occasional ochre accents caught inside the pattern. Puffy white interruptions cross the darker mass, and broad low wave-like bands balance intricate high detail. Diffuse cool light creates gentle tonal modeling without cast shadows. The visual rhythm moves from tightly coiled marks through quiet open space to long horizontal sweeps, making separate textures feel like one continuous dreamlike form.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实墨线淡彩插画把大型有机体块与大气、风景般肌理融合。准确细排线和版刻卷线在上部愈发密集，平滑象牙留白让小块中央轮廓保持可读。墨蓝黑、石板灰与淡奶油主导，偶尔的赭色点缀藏在花纹里。蓬松白色断口横穿较暗体块，低位宽波形带平衡上方繁细细节。漫射冷光形成温和明度塑形，没有投影。视觉节奏从紧卷笔痕经过安静空处走向长水平扫线，让不同肌理如同一个连续梦境形体。
theme_en: A profile figure whose elaborate hair merges with clouds above a dark sea
theme_zh: 一位侧面人物的繁复发髻与暗海上方云层交融
name: Katie Scott
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
